a_1 = 2 a_2 = -3, a_3 = -1/2, a_4 = 1/3, a_5 = 2 The sequence repeats every 4 terms with cycle (2, -3, -1/2, 1/3) The product of one full 4-term cycle is 1 2015 = 4*503 + 3, so there are 503 full cycles and 3 remaining terms The 503 full cycles contribute product 1
After 503 full cycles ending at a_2012, the remaining 3 terms are a_2013, a_2014, and a_2015. This step omits a_2013 and lists only two terms, so the subsequent product is incomplete.
Compute the product of all three remaining terms a_2013, a_2014, a_2015 using the cycle values 2, -3, -1/2.
</reflection>
